about: Flags of nations and federations of another day that flag-icons does not have (docs/design/football-years.md, 'Federations of the day'; docs/design/historic-maps.md, 'Names of the day'). Each is a public-domain SVG from Wikimedia Commons, read 2026-11-09 (the first five) and 2026-11-10 (East Germany, South Vietnam, the United Arab Republic) from the file page named (robots.txt allows /wiki/ pages and upload.wikimedia.org), committed under scripts/data/historic-flags/ and redrawn on flag-icons' 4:3 canvas (640 x 480) by npm run build:historic-flags, which writes public/flags/<file>.svg; --check rebuilds them byte for byte. The redrawing keeps every path of the original: the flag is scaled by its height to 480 and cut to 640 wide, at the fly for a flag whose emblem sits in the canton, evenly on both sides for a centred one; a plain field is redrawn as rectangles in the new coordinates. sha256 is the original as served by upload.wikimedia.org, lfSha256 the committed snapshot (git keeps text with LF line endings).

flags.name: Soviet Union
flags.licence: Public domain: not an object of copyright under article 1259 of Book IV of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation (Commons: PD-RU-exempt), as the file page states

flags.name: Yugoslavia (SFR Yugoslavia)
flags.licence: Public domain: ineligible for copyright (simple geometry, official insignia) and expired under Yugoslav copyright law (Commons: PD-ineligible, PD-shape, PD-Yugoslavia), as the file page states

flags.name: FR Yugoslavia, then Serbia and Montenegro
flags.licence: Public domain: an official act of state authorities under the copyright law of Serbia and Montenegro, and ineligible for copyright, a simple geometric design (Commons: PD-SCGGov, PD-ineligible, PD-shape), as the file page states

flags.name: Zaire
flags.licence: Public domain: first published in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and out of copyright under its Ordinance-Law No. 86-033 of 5 April 1986, and ineligible for copyright (Commons: PD-Democratic Republic of the Congo, PD-ineligible), as the file page states

flags.name: CIS (the flag of its team at Euro 1992)
flags.licence: Public domain: simple geometric shapes and text, below the threshold of originality (Commons: PD-textlogo), as the file page states; its structured data also dedicates it to the public domain (CC0) from its uploader, B1mbo, who drew it

flags.name: East Germany (German Democratic Republic)
flags.licence: Public domain: the flag of a German body governed by public law, and under section 5 (1) of the German Copyright Act official works such as flags are in the public domain (gemeinfrei), as the file page states

flags.name: South Vietnam (Republic of Vietnam)
flags.licence: Public domain: simple geometry, ineligible for copyright (Commons: PD-ineligible), as the file page states

flags.name: United Arab Republic (Egypt until 1971)

commons.title: File:Flag of the United Arab Republic (1958–1971), Flag of Syria (1980–2024).svg

flags.licence: Public domain: an Egyptian work out of copyright in Egypt under Intellectual Property Law 82 of 2002 (Commons: PD-Egypt), as the file page states (which also offers it under the GFDL and CC BY-SA 3.0)
